name: ZenRows
tagline: Anti-bot web scraping API with JavaScript rendering and proxy rotation
description: ZenRows is a web scraping API that handles anti-bot protections, CAPTCHAs, JavaScript rendering, and rotating residential proxies so developers can extract HTML or structured data from hard-to-scrape sites without managing their own proxy infrastructure.

auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter (self-serve signup). Also supported as header in some SDKs.

use_cases: scrape HTML from anti-bot protected sites
extract structured data via CSS selectors
